name: Mumbai BKC (underground)
note: approx. - Wikipedia; on the OSM-mapped tunnel 350 m from its west end (+/-200 m along the line). Underground: rail ~26 m below ground (JICA FAD 2018), platforms ~24 m, box ~32 m deep (press). leg=tunnel: bored to the next point

name: Vikhroli shaft (creek west bank)
note: approx. - the OSM-mapped line's kink where the Vikhroli shaft (~56 m deep) is reported; the creek crossing starts east of here. A via point: it splits the bored length so the 'Viaduct instead of tunnel' option crosses the creek on viaduct from here (the 2015 study's ALT2)

name: Shilphata tunnel portal
note: approx. - OSM: tunnel-to-viaduct change on the mapped line, 21.0 km from BKC, matching NHSRCL's 21 km BKC-Shilphata tunnel; position not surveyed (+/- a few hundred m). JICA 2018 gives rail 30.146 m at Km 21/112 - enter it under level to hold the portal to it. leg=elevated: viaduct onwards

name: Thane
note: approx. - OSM node 'Thane Station' (railway=construction), 5 m from the mapped line, ~7.1 km past the portal; elevated, Mhatardi-Dativali near Diva. Wikipedia's 19.1890 73.0594 is 416 m off the line
